name: I Hate Money
tagline: A simple shared budget manager web application
description: I hate money is a web application made to ease shared budget management. It keeps track of who bought what, when, and for whom; and helps to settle the bills.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Mysql root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-ihatemoney application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-ihatemoney
  # The `big-bear-ihatemoney` service definition
  big-bear-ihatemoney:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-ihatemoney
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: ihatemoney/ihatemoney:7.2.1@sha256:009d1520552782765c8c41750262cc69410be7ac616f93a9f371556e472f23c6
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY} # Sets the secret key environment variable for the application.
      SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI: mysql+pymysql://bigbear:${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}@big-bear-ihatemoney-db/ihatemoney # Database connection string.
      ACTIVATE_ADMIN_DASHBOARD: "True" # Enables the admin dashboard.
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: "" # Sets the admin password. On the host run: docker run -it --rm --entrypoint ihatemoney ihatemoney/ihatemoney generate_password_hash
      SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE: "False" # Disables secure session cookies for development.
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8001 of the host to port 8000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
    networks:
      - big_bear_ihatemoney_network # Connects the service to a network.
  # Define a service named 'big-bear-ihatemoney-db' for the database.
  big-bear-ihatemoney-db:
    image: mariadb:10@sha256:be981e4113326ada8d6004174dd09eeaefc03094037f811182a52d4f2e737350 # Use MariaDB version 10 Docker image.
    container_name: big-bear-ihatemoney-db # Custom container name.
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD} # Root password for MariaDB.
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ihatemoney # Default database name.
      MYSQL_USER: bigbear # Username for MariaDB.
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD} # Password for the MariaDB user.
    ports:
      - "3306:3306" # Maps MySQL port 3306 inside the container to port 3306 on the host.
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql # Maps a volume for data persistence.
    networks:
      - big_bear_ihatemoney_network # Connects the MySQL service to the network.
networks:
  big_bear_ihatemoney_network: # Define a network named 'big_bear_ihatemoney_network'.
    driver: bridge # Use the bridge network driver.
